tools.name: get_dashboard_summary
tools.title: Get dashboard summary
tools.description: High-level snapshot of the signed-in user's journal: all-time and last-30-day performance, top sessions and pairs, account balances, and the most recent trades.

tools.name: get_performance_metrics
tools.title: Get performance metrics
tools.description: Compute the signed-in user's performance metrics: win rate, net P/L, profit factor, expectancy, average win/loss and average R. Optionally scoped to a date range, and optionally broken down by session, asset, setup or grade.

days.description: Alternative to from/to: last N days.

group_by.description: Optional breakdown dimension: session, asset, setup or grade.

tools.name: get_equity_curve
tools.title: Get equity curve
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's cumulative P/L curve over time, with peak equity and max drawdown. Optionally scoped to a date range and offset by a starting balance.

starting_balance.description: Balance the curve starts from. Default 0.

tools.name: get_period_stats
tools.title: Get monthly or weekly statistics
tools.description: Break the signed-in user's performance down by month or by week (net P/L, win rate, profit factor, trade count per period). Useful for month-over-month comparison and weekly reporting.

limit.description: Max periods returned, most recent first. Default 12.

tools.name: get_trade_stats
tools.title: Get trade performance stats
tools.description: Compute aggregate performance stats (trade count, win rate, total P/L, average R) across the signed-in user's trades, optionally filtered to the last N days.

days.description: Only include trades from the last N days. Omit for all-time stats.

tools.name: list_trades
tools.title: List and filter trades
tools.description: List the signed-in user's trades with optional filters (pair/asset, session, setup, grade, result, direction, market, date range) plus sorting and pagination. Returns core trade fields.

asset.description: Filter by pair/asset symbol, e.g. XAUUSD.

session.description: Filter by session, e.g. London, New York.

grade.description: Filter by trade grade: A+, A, B, C.

result.description: Filter by result: Win, Loss, Breakeven, Untriggered Setup, Cancelled.

direction.description: Filter by direction: Long or Short.

market.description: Filter by market, e.g. Forex, Crypto, Indices.

min_rr.description: Only trades whose actual RR is >= this value.

sort.description: Sort field: date, profit_loss, actual_rr, planned_rr. Default date.

order.description: Sort order: asc or desc. Default desc.

offset.description: Rows to skip for pagination. Default 0.

tools.name: search_trades
tools.title: Search trades by text
tools.description: Free-text search across the signed-in user's trades. Matches notes, setup, asset, session and grade. Use for questions like 'losing XAUUSD trades' or 'trades where I mention FOMO'.

query.description: Text to search for in notes, setup, asset or session.

tools.name: get_trade
tools.title: Get a trade by ID
tools.description: Fetch one full trade record (including notes, confluences, psychology, management and analysis) by its ID, scoped to the signed-in user. Any chart screenshots are returned as freshly signed, currently valid URLs in `media` (and the image fields are refreshed in place), because the URLs stored on the row expire.

expires_in.description: Lifetime in seconds for the freshly signed media URLs (60-86400). Default 3600.

tools.name: list_recent_trades
tools.title: List recent trades
tools.description: List the signed-in user's most recent trades from TG Master Journal, ordered by date. Returns core fields (asset, direction, session, setup, grade, planned/actual RR, P/L, result).

tools.name: get_daily_plan
tools.title: Get daily trading plan
tools.description: Fetch the signed-in user's daily trading plan for a specific date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today when no date is supplied.

date.description: Plan date in YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

tools.name: list_daily_plans
tools.title: List daily plans
tools.description: List the signed-in user's daily plans with bias, session focus, risk limits, review status and pair count. Use `get_daily_plan` for the full detail of one day.

reviewed.description: Filter by whether the plan has been reviewed.

tools.name: get_weekly_plan
tools.title: Get weekly plan and review
tools.description: Fetch the signed-in user's weekly plan (bias, markets, setups, key levels, risk, goals, per-pair analyses, news and review notes) for a given week start date. Defaults to the most recent week.

week_start.description: Week start date in YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the latest week.

tools.name: get_checklist
tools.title: Get trading checklist, progress and streak
tools.description: Fetch the signed-in user's daily trading checklist for a date (defaults to today) with per-section progress, plus recent history and completion streaks.

date.description: Checklist date in YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

history_days.description: How many days of history to include. Default 30, 0 to skip.

tools.name: search_notebook
tools.title: Search and list notebook entries
tools.description: List or free-text search the signed-in user's notebook/journal entries (pair, category, bias, journal text). Use for questions like 'notes about liquidity' or 'entries mentioning FOMO'.

query.description: Text to match in journal text, pair, category or bias. Omit to list all.

tools.name: search_journal
tools.title: Search the whole journal
tools.description: Free-text search across everything the signed-in user has written: trade notes and analysis, notebook entries, daily plans and weekly plans. Returns ranked results with snippets showing where the term matched.

query.description: Text to search for, e.g. 'liquidity sweep' or 'revenge trade'.

sources.description: Comma-separated subset of: trades, notebook, daily_plans, weekly_plans. Defaults to all.

tools.name: analyze_mistakes
tools.title: Analyze recurring mistakes
tools.description: Find the signed-in user's most frequent trading mistakes / rule violations and quantify their cost: occurrences, win rate and net P/L of trades where each mistake appeared, plus recent examples.

days.description: Alternative to from/to: last N days.

limit.description: How many distinct mistakes to return. Default 15.

tools.name: analyze_setups
tools.title: Rank strongest and weakest setups
tools.description: Rank the signed-in user's setups (and optionally assets, sessions, grades, direction, market condition or timeframe) by net P/L, win rate, profit factor and expectancy, highlighting the strongest and weakest performers.

dimension.description: What to rank: setup (default), asset, session, grade, direction, market_condition or timeframe.

days.description: Alternative to from/to: last N days.

min_trades.description: Ignore buckets with fewer trades than this. Default 3.

tools.name: analyze_psychology
tools.title: Analyze psychology and discipline
tools.description: Correlate the signed-in user's emotional state, discipline flags, trade grades and market sentiment with trading outcomes: which emotions precede wins or losses, and how discipline affects P/L.

days.description: Alternative to from/to: last N days.

tools.name: get_consistency_report
tools.title: Get consistency and discipline report
tools.description: Measure the signed-in user's process consistency: planning coverage (days planned vs traded), checklist completion, plan review rate, risk/size consistency, overtrading days and mistake-free rate.

tools.name: get_monthly_summary
tools.title: Get monthly trading summary
tools.description: Full synthesis of one calendar month for the signed-in user: metrics, equity curve, best/worst days, setup and session breakdowns, top mistakes, and plan/checklist adherence.

month.description: Month in YYYY-MM. Defaults to the current month.

tools.name: get_weekly_report
tools.title: Get weekly trading report
tools.description: Synthesis of one trading week for the signed-in user: metrics, day-by-day P/L, setup/session breakdown, mistakes, plus the weekly plan (bias, goals, pair analyses) and its review status.

week_start.description: Monday of the week in YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the current week.

tools.name: get_media_url
tools.title: Get a fresh signed media URL
tools.description: Mint short-lived signed URLs for the signed-in user's journal media (chart screenshots, attachments). Accepts storage paths or stale/expired journal-media URLs and returns currently valid links a client can open or fetch.

paths.description: Storage paths or existing journal-media URLs (e.g. from list_media or a trade's prediction_image).

expires_in.description: Signed URL lifetime in seconds (60-86400). Default 3600.

tools.name: list_media
tools.title: List journal media attachments
tools.description: List the media (chart screenshots and attachments) referenced by the signed-in user's trades, daily plans and notebook entries, optionally within a date range or for one trade. Set `sign: true` to also return short-lived signed URLs.

trade_id.description: Only media attached to this trade.

sources.description: Comma-separated subset of: trades, notebook, daily_plans. Defaults to all.

sign.description: Also mint signed URLs for each item. Default false.

expires_in.description: Signed URL lifetime in seconds when sign is true.

limit.description: Max media items to return. Default 50.
